testcase.name: an exact public key text mention counts while ordinary addressing does not
a signed mention list qualifies without a public key token in the text
an ordinary signed repost retains its original while commentary remains a quote
a username mention qualifies only with a registrar proof for the active owner
null optional commentary remains a valid ordinary repost for both activity readers
a signed commentary quote with a parent field is not classified as a reply
current and legacy commentary quotes retain their authenticated original
